Scanning CoreFlow.

This is an open opportunity, stage: negotiation, $142K, close date 2026-09-11 (SFDC).

Engagement concentration: our relationship sits almost entirely in Lifecycle Marketing and Marketing Ops. Chris Jones (Head of Lifecycle Marketing) is flagged as champion and has appeared on all three recorded calls: Discovery on 2026-06-17, Pricing Review on 2026-06-22, and QBR on 2026-06-24 (Gong). Nicole Anderson, Stephanie Clark, and Daniel Davis joined at least one call each. Robert Smith (CMO) appeared on the Discovery call, which may indicate early executive visibility, though he has not been on a call since.

Gaps: no recorded engagement with Victor Osei (VP Engineering), Priya Raman (VP Finance), or Margaret Chen (CEO). Finance and Engineering are uncontacted in our data.

Lifecycle team complexity: the org chart shows two people carrying the Head of Lifecycle Marketing title, Chris Jones and Daniel Davis, both at 0.85 confidence (org data, 2026-08-06). The relationship and champion flag sit with Jones. Whether Davis is a peer, a duplicate enrichment row, or a recent addition is not resolved in the data and worth verifying.

The pricing review on 2026-06-22 surfaced pushback on pricing thresholds and volume discount structure, per the Gong summary. No verbatim quote is available.

Open role: a Director of Lifecycle Marketing posting is active as of 2026-07-24 (linkedin.com/jobs/view/49b2ddff), which would sit above both current Heads. That person, if hired, would likely inherit or influence this evaluation.

Low-confidence rows: Priya Raman (VP Finance, 0.55), Tom Bradley (Staff Engineer, 0.45), and Nicole Williams (Marketing Operations Specialist, 0.50) should be verified before being treated as confirmed contacts.
